entry_points.restrict_reference(p,n,assignment,genera: Returns residuals list and counters; does not extract a witness.
entry_points.extract_reference(p,n,assignment,generat: Direct original-generator restriction with binary prefix search.
entry_points.extract_sweep(p,n,assignment,generators): Original-term incidence sweep with completed-batch qualification.

inputs.p: Exact built-in int >= 2; externally assumed prime, not proved here.
inputs.assignment: Exact built-in int, 0 <= assignment < 2**n; bit i is x_i.
inputs.generators: Built-in list or tuple of built-in dicts. Keys are exact int masks in [0,2**n); values exact int in [1,p). Empty dictionary denotes zero. Booleans rejected. No concurrent caller mutation permitted.
inputs.depth: restrict_reference only: exact built-in int in [0,n].

output.found: depth, prefix, generator_index, constant are ints. Prefix is assignment & ((1 << depth)-1); constant in [1,p). Index is lowest qualifying generator at least qualifying prefix depth.
output.no_scalar_witness: All four witness fields are null; establishes all full polynomial evaluations zero, not domain validity.
output.counters: Integer structural-event counts, reproducible for identical ordered input. Insertion-order permutations can alter intermediate cancellation/deletion counts while preserving witnesses and final residuals. No elapsed-time or bit-cost claim.

counter_semantics.validation_generator_headers: Generators copied and type-checked; independent of algorithm headers.
counter_semantics.validation_term_visits: Input terms validated and copied; includes snapshot dictionary write per visit.
counter_semantics.generator_headers: Algorithm generator visits; sweep initialization or direct restriction per query.
counter_semantics.original_term_visits: Original terms visited by algorithm after validation.
counter_semantics.incidences_built: Original term-variable memberships appended to buckets; includes low-bit bit_length extraction per entry.
counter_semantics.incidence_visits: Bucket term IDs inspected, including dead terms.
counter_semantics.dictionary_initial_writes: Sweep initial aggregate entries; validated snapshots counted separately.
counter_semantics.dictionary_adds: Modular addition updates, each with one aggregate get and possible write/delete; not all dictionary operations.
counter_semantics.dictionary_subtractions: Modular subtraction updates, including missing-key subtraction from zero.
counter_semantics.dictionary_deletes: Existing aggregate keys removed after zero result.
counter_semantics.mask_operations: Explicit shift, AND, XOR and complement operators on masks/assignment; excludes arithmetic negation/subtraction, bit_length, comparisons, hashing, allocations and integer bit costs.
counter_semantics.predicate_checks: Whole-prefix existence queries, only at complete states.
counter_semantics.variable_batches: Sweep variable buckets processed, including empty ones.
counter_semantics.touched_set_adds: Attempted touched-generator insertion per live incidence.
counter_semantics.touched_generator_updates: Distinct touched generator processed per completed batch.
counter_semantics.qualifying_set_updates: Add or discard attempts; includes initial successful insertions.
counter_semantics.tie_break_visits: Reference ascending generator visits per query, overlapping generator predicate work; sweep qualifying-set entries visited once at successful stop.
counter_semantics.full_validity_checks: Sweep final empty-residual assertions. Reference validity follows from false full-depth predicate and is counted in predicate work.
counter_semantics.multiplier_entries: Always zero: no multiplier vector allocated.

failure_semantics: Malformed inputs raise ValueError. Internal invariant failures raise AssertionError. Other exceptions/interruption propagate; no catch converts them to no_scalar_witness. No partial result/callback/checkpoint API.

complexity.reference: O((s+T)*(1+log(n+1))) structural bookkeeping upper bound plus validation, expected dictionary probes and non-unit mask/arithmetic costs; snapshot O(s+T) entries plus up to two transient residual dictionaries during extraction because the previous local remains referenced while the next is constructed. restrict_reference additionally retains every returned residual, O(s+T) output entries.
complexity.sweep: O(n+s+T+I) structural bookkeeping and entries, expected hash probes. One O(s) final tie scan upper bound; no per-depth all-generator scan. Not a bit complexity guarantee.

security_boundary: Witness-only producer output is untrusted. Future integration must independently reconstruct ALL original residuals before certificate construction/checking; do not trust internal sweep dictionaries.
scope: Shortest fixed-order prefix only within scalar-inverse single-original-generator constant family. No arbitrary-support/global proof minimality, prime certification, projection truncation, degree-of-regularity or measured speedup claim.
execution: No candidate imports/execution/tests/solver or field enumeration performed under source task.
